slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly intelligent

memorising poems

memorise one short poem a month and say it out loud on your walks. it trains your memory like a muscle, and you'll be surprised how often a line fits a moment.

grocery mental math

add up your groceries in your head before you reach the till, every single time. it sounds tiny, but daily mental math keeps your brain fast in a way scrolling never will.

documentary notes

watch one documentary a week and write down 3 things you didn't know before. turning watching into noting is the difference between being entertained and getting smarter.

curiosity minutes

every day, spend 5 minutes on one question you've always wondered about: why the sky is blue, how money was invented. answering your own questions keeps you curious for life.
slides.texte_sophia:
curiosity minutes

every day, spend 5 minutes on one question you've always wondered about: how money was invented. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and it keeps you curious for life.

slides.texte_overlay:
the blank page test

once a week, write everything you know about a topic on a blank page without looking anything up. then check. you'll see what you really know versus what only feels familiar.
